title: Government of NCT Delhi RTI Online citizen manual
provision: Portal form, fee, attachment and first-appeal workflow
excerpt: The manual shows a ten-rupee application fee, PDF supporting documents up to one megabyte, and online first appeal after 30 days or department disposal.
notes: Downloaded as inert data, size-capped, signature checked, hashed and scanned with Microsoft Defender. Sample personal details in the manual are intentionally not reproduced in project data.

technical.notes: Relevant operational constraints inspected; FAQ character limit takes precedence over inconsistent screenshot wording.

legalRti.notes: Portal behavior must be reviewed with the applicable rules.
